The *Abyākatakathā* (Kv 14.8) is a debate located in the fourteenth chapter of the *Kathāvatthu*, the fifth book of the Theravāda Abhidhamma Piṭaka [SuttaCentral]. Although the keyword-matched secondary literature focuses broadly on the Abhidhammic category of kammically indeterminate (*abyākata*) dhammas or the unanswered metaphysical questions (*abyākata*) of the Sutta Piṭaka without discussing this specific controversy, the *Kathāvatthu* text constitutes an analytical debate on the topic [SuttaCentral]. According to SuttaCentral, the text is represented by one modern translation and is closely linked to several canonical discourses, including the *Bījasutta* (AN 10.104), AN 1.314, the *Kukkuravatika Sutta* (MN 57), the *Mahāvaccha Sutta* (MN 73), the *Moggallānasutta* (SN 44.7), and their counterpart in the Chinese *Saṁyuktāgama* (SĀ 787–788) [SuttaCentral].

Segments §7.11–7.14 further match passages in the *Abyākata Saṁyutta* (SN 44.11), the *Citta Saṁyutta* (SN 41.3), and the *Dukanikkhepa* of the *Dhammasaṅgaṇī* (Ds 2.3.2) [DharmaNexus]. The debate also shares stock argumentative structures with numerous other *Kathāvatthu* sections, such as the *Rūpaṁkammantikathā* (Kv 8.9) and the *Sabbamatthītikathā* (Kv 1.6) [DharmaNexus].
